name: whoa-food
description: A small browser-based educational food categorization game.

scripts.dev: npm run validate:data && nodemon --legacy-watch --watch server.js --watch views --watch public --watch data --ignore node_modules server.js
scripts.pm2:start: npm run validate:data && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
scripts.pm2:restart: npm run validate:data && pm2 restart whoa-food
